title: Harry Potter season fondue (brown Meltie mug, dining table)
notes: Replica of the Short with ONLY the setting changed: the treats on a dark oak dining table in a dining room at night (linen runner, upholstered dining chairs, a sideboard with dried pampas and a round mirror, a warm pendant light) instead of the white desk in front of red curtains. Table decor kept: small orange pumpkins, the pumpkin-gnome figure, the candle jar, the laptop. BROWN variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photo IMG_3996 + brown lifestyle photo; the original uses the cream one). Hook reworded as asked (same meaning, length and place). The pour (s3) and the last shot (s8) spill chocolate on purpose (brief). The laptop is a green screen composited with original generated fantasy stills (no film footage, no real actors); the KitKat bag is a plain unbranded red bag; Sora audio.

product.name: Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug, brown
product.description: the BROWN Meltie Mini Fondue Mug exactly as in the product photos: glossy chocolate-brown ceramic body that flares wider at the top, a white interior, 'Chocolate...' in white cursive script with a small white swirl mark on the front, a tall arched opening at the base for a tealight, an angular brown handle on the right with a small round hole, and a fondue fork with a terracotta-brown handle and long steel tines that clips into the handle

style: Cosy autumn movie night at home in the evening, at the DINING TABLE: everything happens on a dark oak dining table in a dining room; a dim warm room, deep soft shadows, warm amber pendant light, no bright studio light, no red curtains. Handheld vertical phone video at table height, shallow depth of field, rich warm autumn colour grade. Hands have long glossy pale-pink manicured nails. The laptop screen is always flat chroma-key green. No on-screen text, no logos.

shots.prompt: One continuous static take, no camera move. 0-0.8 s: the fork lifts the strawberry up from the board and moves it over the brim-full mug. 0.8-1.8 s: it pushes the strawberry straight DOWN INTO the mug until it disappears under the melted chocolate; the chocolate surges up and OVERFLOWS: a big wave of glossy melted chocolate spills over the rim on all sides and pours down the brown outside of the mug in thick streams. 1.8-2.3 s: the strawberry stays under while thick chocolate keeps pouring down the outside of the mug and pools in a puddle on the table around its base. 2.3-3.5 s: it rises slowly straight back up out of the mug, fully coated in glossy chocolate, dripping, while the overflow keeps running down the mug into the growing puddle. 3.5-4 s: held still just above the mug. The strawberry stays on the fork the whole time. Lots of spilled chocolate.
